page.layout: One title page, centred, within an ornamental border of fleurons on all four sides. Printed lines: "DE", "JURAMENTI" (red), "Promissorii", "OBLIGATIONE" (red), "Prælectiones Septem." (italic).; One title page: centred lines of text in the middle, with ornamental borders down both sides and a row of ornaments at the foot, which are not text.

main_text.l: Typis T. R. & E. M. Prostat væ nale apud
O. Pullen & A. Crook, in Cœmeterio S. Pauli 1647.

page.notes: Handwritten ink inscription across the upper title ("Ser. Gridley", with a flourish), not printed, so not transcribed. The page is set within a decorative fleuron border, with no other printed text. The ornamental borders and the row of ornaments at the foot are not transcribed. Long s is given as plain s throughout.
